title: UtilityCraft MITE
description: A mod that adds many Utility tools and items to MITE.
body:
## What is added to this mod ?
**Obsidian ship**.  Sitting on the top will not be scalded by the lower lava.
![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a1137c00f0de7613a1afa303237183adab14a11c.png)

**New series of sabers** Sweeping injury；**New series of Rapier** Armor piercing；**New series of Paxel**  A collection of pickaxe ，shovel and axe have been added. 
![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/bc7341ddbee7a63ba98a3ccdfbf09ac85ef1f613.png)

**A variety of metal storage chest**.  With a storage space of 133 slots.
![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/ef24268f9ff33bfa3d456de9e9c8c25eb1d13586.png)
![Screenshot](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/d8118cc8fe3ec2a0a45a4b5294ec4036155020e8.png)
